material_description: (unlabelled 1) | carbon molecular sieve hollow fiber membrane made by pyrolysis of asymmetric P84 co-polyimide (BTDA-TDI/MDI, Lenzing) hollow fibers spun by dry/wet phase inversion; pyrolysis in flowing N2 (150 cm3/min), 373 K for 30 min, then 5 K/min to 1173 K, 5 min hold, cooled at 10 K/min
source_location: main-5 (journal p. 629), Fig. 6 (Low pressure hydrogen adsorption/desorption at 77 K), series 'Desorption' (open diamonds)
notes: archive: fig6_desorption.json; archive point index 6; digitized P = 201.28 mbar, 5.1613 mmol/g (marker centroid at pixel 764.50, 1203.10; 20 px); open marker located by the centroid of its white fill (series isolated by colour #ffffff); y axis printed as 'Volume (mmol/g)', read as H2 uptake in mmol/g; x axis 'P (mbar)' converted to bar (/1000); uptake basis not named for H2 (volumetric Quantachrome Autosorb-1, so excess by instrumental default; the 'excess isotherms' statement in section 2.7 refers to the gravimetric IGA CO2/N2/CH4 data only); surface area: Langmuir s.s.a.
